description: Replay a session's recorded turns in order.

include_superseded.description: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

page_size.description: Lossless mode records per page (1-64, default 16)

session_id.description: Target session (required explicit UUID for lossless; otherwise default most recent)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

turn_types.description: Selective mode: turn types to keep

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

name: session.replay

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

title: Replay a session
